chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn 'Amr ibn Sa'id, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, from Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal عليه السلام, who said: I heard him say:

“I shrouded my father in two Shatwi garments in which he used to enter ihram, and in a shirt from among his shirts, and in a turban that had belonged to 'Ali ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام, and in a cloak that I bought for forty dinars; if it were today, it would be worth four hundred dinars.”

key_terms.ثَوْبَيْنِ: two garments used as part of the burial shroud
key_terms.دِينَارًا: a gold coin used as a measure of value
key_terms.يُحْرِمُ: he would enter the state of ihram for hajj or 'umrah

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about how an Imam عليه السلام shrouded his father for burial?
ai.summary: This hadith reports how the Imam عليه السلام prepared his father for burial, specifying the garments used for his kafan. It reflects burial practice, familial reverence, and the mention of the cloak’s high value highlights both its quality and the honor given in the shrouding.
